issues.span: जिस परम सौंपने से सौंपा है
issues.evidence: Tibetan "ཡོངས་སུ་གཏད་པའི་དམ་པ་ཇི་སྙེད་པས་ཡོངས་སུ་གཏད་པ" = entrusted with how-great a supreme entrusting (Skt parīndanā). The Hindi uses the infinitive "सौंपने" as an abstract noun with instrumental, which is awkward and hard to parse; meaning is intact.
issues.fix: जिस परम समर्पण (परीन्दना) से सौंपा है

issues.evidence: Tibetan "ཡོངས་སུ་གཏད་པའི་དམ་པས་ཡོངས་སུ་གཏད་དོ" = entrusted with the supreme entrusting (Skt parīndanayā parīndita). The infinitive "सौंपने" used as a noun is awkward Hindi; meaning intact.

issues.span: सरल नहीं है; इसी कारण से।
issues.evidence: Tibetan ends "ཚད་གཟུང་བར་སླ་བ་མ་ཡིན་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ" = "because ... is not easy to measure": the final ཕྱིར་རོ marks the non-measurability as the ground (cf. 5-1, same sentence, "क्योंकि"). The Hindi turns it into a trailing "इसी कारण से" (for this very reason), which makes the non-measurability a consequence of something prior and leaves the sentence dangling; the logical direction of the reason is changed/lost.
issues.fix: भगवान ने कहा: हे सुभूति, उसी प्रकार, क्योंकि किसी में भी अप्रतिष्ठित होकर दान देने वाले बोधिसत्त्व की पुण्यराशि का माप करना, सुभूति, सरल नहीं है।

issues.evidence: Tibetan "མཚན་དང་མཚན་མ་མེད་པར་བལྟའོ" = to be viewed with marks (མཚན) and without signs (མཚན་མ). Kamalaśīla (bo-kamalasila-tika 3-51): viewed by marks conventionally, without marks ultimately. "के रूप में" (as) says the Tathāgata is to be seen as a mark, not as possessing marks; the "with marks" sense is imprecise.
